title: A Debt in Steel
description: A debtor of the Wagering Ring has three days to settle twelve silver he doesn't have — in coin, in kind, or in blood, properly witnessed. Widowmaker Alley is where the paperwork always ends.

phase_the_challenge.objectiveText: Witness the Bookkeeper read the terms of Anselm Draye's debt.

phase_the_second.objectiveText: Anselm Draye is asking for a favor — hear him out.

phase_arrival_widowmaker.objectiveText: Stand with Anselm at Widowmaker Alley when the debt comes due.

phase_the_offer.objectiveText: Anselm wants you to fight in his place. Decide.

phase_the_duel.objectiveText: Face Duro Vantry in Anselm's stead.

phase_the_reckoning.objectiveText: The duel is over — see how the debt is settled.

phase_resolved.objectiveText: The debt is settled, one way or another.
